agents.title: Agents
agents.cannotLimitCommands: This connection cannot enforce a command prefix list. Choose asking before commands or commands inside the sandbox.
agents.cannotConfineCommands: This connection cannot keep arbitrary commands inside the worktree. Choose asking before commands or an allowed list.
agents.cannotBlockNetwork: This connection cannot block network access on this platform. Network stays on.

mechanism.codexCommandApprovals: Codex App Server · one command approval
mechanism.claudeEditToolsRemoved: edit tools off · list runs · others ask
mechanism.claudeEditRules: allowed tools · edit rules per folder
mechanism.claudeWebToolsRemoved: web tools off · commands keep network
mechanism.nativeWriteToolsWithheld: write tools withheld · reads stay in the worktree
mechanism.nativeFileScopeFolders: file tools · also these folders · commands not confined
mechanism.nativeCommandApprovals: Orchester asks you before each command
mechanism.nativeCommandList: listed and known-safe commands run unconfined · others ask you

agents.outsideChange: This profile changed elsewhere. Your edits are kept here; reload the saved profile before saving again.
agents.connectionReset: The connection changed. Review its model and permissions before saving.
agents.mcpLimit: The maximum number of MCP servers is selected.
agents.description: Each profile is a role for pipeline steps: what the agent is for, the connection and model it runs on, and what it may do.
agents.importUnavailable: Importing agents is not built in this app yet.
agents.emptyDetail: A profile is the role a pipeline step runs: what the agent is for, the connection and model it uses, and what it may do in the repository. Pipelines can use a profile once it is published.
agents.noConnections: Agents run on a project connection: an agent CLI such as Claude Code or Codex. Add a connection first, then create profiles.
agents.needsConnection: New agent needs a project connection.
agents.versionNote: Edits save as a draft. Publishing makes it the version new runs use; runs that already started keep theirs.
agents.stale: Draft based on v{{base}} · Published v{{version}}
agents.staleNote: v{{version}} was published after this draft started. Keeping this draft replaces that version’s changes.
agents.keepTitle: Keep this draft over the published version?
agents.firstNote: Pipelines can use this profile once v1 is published.
agents.widenTitle: Allow these changes to the agent profile?
agents.failed: The profile could not be saved
agents.gone: This profile is no longer available.
agents.roleHint: Shown in pipelines, runs and approvals.
agents.responsibilityHint: One line on what this agent is for. People and planners read it.
agents.connectionHint: The agent CLI and sign-in this profile runs on.
agents.modelHint: From the connection’s list, or Other model id… for one that isn’t listed.
agents.effortHint: CLI default leaves it to the connection’s own setting.
agents.assignmentNote: Runs keep their exact connection, model and effort until they end.
agents.instructionsHint: Added to every run of this profile, after the project rules.
agents.readOnlyHint: Reads the repository. Can’t change files or commit.
agents.writeTitle: Edit files in the task worktree
agents.writeHint: Changes stay in the task’s own worktree and branch.
agents.foldersHint: Only with Edit files. Folders outside the worktree this agent may also change.
agents.folderNote: Your home folder, the repository root and system folders can’t be added.
agents.askHint: Every command waits for your approval in Needs you.
agents.allowedHint: These run without asking. Anything else asks you first.
agents.anyHint: Runs without asking, confined to the task worktree.
agents.commandNote: Entries match by prefix: cargo test also allows cargo test -p api.
agents.networkHint: Package installs, web requests and git fetch.
agents.mcpNone: This project has no MCP servers yet. Agents work without them.
agents.mcpHint: The server keeps its own access to files and network.
agents.whenAskedHint: Some CLIs still ask before actions these permissions allow. Requests outside them always wait for you.
agents.toolCallsHint: Ask a person before each MCP or app tool call.
agents.nativeUnavailable: This connection does not offer approval switches or MCP servers.
agents.enforcementNote: Every run uses these limits. No setting or mode turns them off.
agents.newRuns: Applies to new runs after publishing.
agents.localRules: Your own CLI rules on this computer still apply.
agents.agentFilesOff: Not loaded; Orchester adds the instructions
agents.publishNote: Publish v{{version}} to use these changes in new runs. Runs that already started keep theirs.
agents.usesNote: Publishing changes what new runs use. Runs that already started or are queued keep their versions.
agents.noUses: This profile is not used in a pipeline yet.
agents.useCounts: {{pipelines}} pipelines · {{steps}} steps · {{overrides}} steps override the model
agents.noActive: No runs are using this profile now.
agents.keepWarning: This draft will replace the changes in the latest published version. Publish it afterwards to use it in new runs.
